hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Validate that the word has at least three characters and consists solely of alphanumeric symbols.

hints.title: Phonetic Criteria
hints.text: Ensure the word contains at least one vowel and at least one consonant.

hints.title: Character Iteration
hints.text: Iterate through each character. If non-alphanumeric, return false. Otherwise, track boolean flags for vowel and consonant presence.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass validating characters against alphanumeric rules.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single linear check is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check character sets and length boundaries cleanly.
